children: A Polymarket submarket tied to the CBLOL playoff match between Vivo Keyd Stars and paiN Gaming saw the probability of the “yes” option for both teams killing one dragon surge from 51.6% one hour earlier to 90%, a 38.4% swing. According to ChainCatcher, the move was monitored by Catcher Predict and was said to be affected by breaking news.

title: Polymarket LoL Submarket Jumps to 90% on Dragon-Kill Outcome
